title: kolpelor
blurb: a Greek-myth monster-tamer built from your Bluesky SimCluster: every moot becomes a θήρ — type, species, and stats pulled from their real profile numbers, wandering one of four homelands (shadowed wood, grey-blue lake, fire-born mountain, bright city) per @antiali.as's own reply-thread verse. strike to weaken, throw a κολπόσφαιρα to bind, storm the gymnasion's fixed ladder of Odyssey trainers (Polyphemus, Circe, the Sirens, Scylla & Charybdis, Poseidon), or scout a rival's live team. win battles and a bound pelor evolves — changes species, grows stronger — while digging a homeland rolls Zeus's fortune: gold, enchanted gear to equip, or his own unforeseen doom. sign in and every region switch writes your position to your own net.bisks.kolpelor.roster record — Wilds' Ἴχνη panel reads your moots' matching records straight off their PDSes to show whose tracks share your homeland, so meeting one in the field means a gift-post or a battle. a live river strip now watches the public Bluesky firehose itself and turns its pace into shared world weather — calm, drizzle, rain, storm — and on a real surge a World Pelor appears to everyone watching at once, built from whichever real account's post rode the spike, per @antiali.as's own verse: 'one world, one flow, we all feel it together.' @antiali.as asked for beast-taming, philia-binding, gymnasion PvP & PvAI, records to the PDS, victory-driven growth, hidden earth-spoils, and a river of living messages that all pelor-tamers share — ἀριστεύε.
